local companies = tool('list_companies', {})
local domain_to_company = {}
for _, c in ipairs(companies) do
  if c.domain then domain_to_company[c.domain] = c.name end
end

local function normalized_phone(phone)
  if not phone or phone == '' then return nil, false end
  -- already valid E.164 US
  if phone:match('^%+1%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d$') then
    return phone, false
  end
  -- extract digits
  local digits = phone:gsub('%D', '')
  if #digits == 10 then
    return '+1' .. digits, true
  elseif #digits == 11 and digits:sub(1,1) == '1' then
    return '+' .. digits, true
  elseif #digits > 0 then
    -- try best effort: if starts with 1 and 11 digits already handled; otherwise prepend +1 if 10
    -- leave unfixable? Task says rewrite every phone not in E.164 into E.164
    if #digits == 11 then
      return '+' .. digits, true
    end
    return '+1' .. digits, true
  end
  return phone, false
end

local phones_fixed = 0
local companies_filled = 0
local page = 1
local total_pages = 1

repeat
  local r = tool('list_contacts', { page = page })
  total_pages = r.total_pages
  for _, ct in ipairs(r.items) do
    local updates = { id = ct.id }
    local need = false

    local new_phone, fixed = normalized_phone(ct.phone)
    if fixed and new_phone then
      updates.phone = new_phone
      need = true
      phones_fixed = phones_fixed + 1
    end

    local company_empty = (not ct.company) or ct.company == ''
    if company_empty and ct.email then
      local domain = ct.email:match('@(.+)$')
      if domain and domain_to_company[domain] then
        updates.company = domain_to_company[domain]
        need = true
        companies_filled = companies_filled + 1
      end
    end

    if need then
      tool('update_contact', updates)
    end
  end
  page = page + 1
until page > total_pages

return { phones_fixed = phones_fixed, companies_filled = companies_filled, domains = domain_to_company }
